completion.binding: runtimeSha256 is the exact binary above; startupDigest exact startup bytes; authoritySourceDigest exact claims source pin; completionRoot actual campaign root/publication; repository/workspaceRoot exact custody paths; custodySha256 exact phase selection bytes.

custody.initialize: Fresh epoch; exact runtime/root/repository/permanent-lock identities; null marker/ledger identities; no publication authority.
custody.active: Separately seal actual resulting marker/ledger identities and preserve same epoch/config; update completion custodySha256 accordingly.

requiredInputs.condition: Must pin this binary and exact source/build inputs; existing installed acceptance or job-policy admission must authorize its actual campaign. Historical episode current_exe pins cannot be migrated or relabeled.

requiredInputs.input: genuine reviewed subject, candidate/parent/tree and gate/physical-profile receipts
requiredInputs.condition: Actual qualified evidence and claims/episode owner readbacks required; fixture or preparation standing insufficient.

requiredInputs.input: claims source/configuration/grants, episode authority and installed acceptance or job policy
requiredInputs.condition: Completion JSON only selects these existing grants; it cannot issue them.

requiredInputs.input: canonical bare destination/ref, initial object import and workspace ledger root
requiredInputs.condition: Select independent managed destination containing exact candidate objects; approve immutable object import and canonical ref allowlist.
Exact protected /usr executable and policy; no fixture /usr/bin/true relabeling.

requiredInputs.input: runtime/operator UID, owner roots, socket directory, epoch and filesystem identities
requiredInputs.condition: Trusted UID1000 permitted only with actual untrusted descendants confined away from authority/canonical state; initialize and active selections separately sealed. Socket parent must be outside /usr; read-only system exposure still grants socket connectivity. Socket admission excludes /usr,/lib,/lib64,/etc/ssl and canonical aliases, selected candidate/reviewer-boundary/validator-workspace roots; actual installed mounts still require observation.
No credential contents or provider calls were accessed; separately authorized current qualification remains required.

readbackAndOrder.action: Review exact source delta and release manifest, approve concrete missing selections/issuance. No installation before that approval.

Install exact binary and source/build inputs under protected ancestry; allocate selected canonical bare repository, permanent lock, ledger and runtime-private socket directory; import only approved genuine objects.

Issue/open actual qualified startup through existing installed acceptance or fixed job-policy admission. Verify source/grant/episode/current_exe and qualified evidence identities; recover original committed review outcome before serving.
Install exact initialize custody bytes and matching completion bytes atomically; read back SHA256, canonical ancestry, UID/mode/device/inode and fixed program pins.
Observe marker/database identities; separately approve/install active custody plus matching completion hash. Preserve initialize bytes, epoch history and owner roots.

readbackAndOrder.expected: One private socket; durable owner reopen, no new review launch or synthesized result.

readbackAndOrder.action: Observe actual reviewer/validator descendant namespaces, mounts, FDs, network grants, guard lifetime and inaccessible owner/canonical/socket paths. Read source/binary/policy and actual owner IDs; source checks do not establish installation.
Inspect package and accept-checkpoint over its displayed digest; separately prepare/show exact offer and make create decision over that displayed digest. Neither accepts/settles the coding job.

Read exact operation/CAS/ref receipt, stop/collect host, inspect/remove only a proven stale socket, cold reopen same installed configuration and read back the exact publication result. Preserve unresolved/unconfirmed state if evidence is insufficient.

rollback.beforeAdmission: Stop/collect host; operator revokes/removes protected selection. Preserve roots, permanent lock, binary/source/selection bytes and epoch history.
rollback.afterAdmissionOrUnknown: No retry, ref reset, marker regeneration, lock replacement or state deletion. Restore only exact approved custody or separately issue a new epoch preserving history; use existing inspect/reconcile and retain unresolved or unconfirmed standing.

notPerformed: No checkpoint acceptance or create decision

repairEvidence.fixtureLimit: Both reviewer constructor and managed validator real descendant denial observed under fixture standing only; actual installed confinement remains unestablished.
repairEvidence.listenerLimit: Actual listener/framing/peer boundary tested with domain callback stub; installed startup not exercised.
